details: The historic trilateral meeting in Shenzhen between US President Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin concluded without decisive solutions to major global conflicts, including Ukraine. Analysts note that while direct confrontation was avoided, deep-seated disagreements and competing interests persist, contributing to ongoing global geopolitical uncertainty.
title: Trump-Xi-Putin Summit Fails to Resolve Conflicts, Markets Wary

details: The Nasdaq Composite erased all its 2026 gains, falling 5.3% on November 20 amidst a broad tech sell-off. Investor confidence in AI profitability wavered as Nvidia shares dropped 14% following an SEC accounting inquiry and the resignation of its CEO over an alleged spy scandal, signaling a repricing of AI investments.
title: Nasdaq Plummets as AI Bubble Bursts, Nvidia Faces SEC Probe

details: The International Energy Agency reports the ongoing Iran war has caused the largest energy supply shock in history, cutting Gulf oil exports by 25% due to Strait of Hormuz disruptions. The IEA's 2026 outlook projects a significant long-term reduction in global oil demand if the shift towards electric and alternative energy accelerates.
title: IEA: Iran War Creates Historic Oil Shock, Gulf Exports Decline

details: Ukraine's successful attacks on Russia's Kerch Bridge to Crimea continue to pressure Russian logistics. In retaliation, Russia launched ballistic missile strikes damaging three bridges across the Dnipro River in Kyiv, intensifying the conflict and further disrupting infrastructure in both regions.
title: Ukraine Strikes Crimean Bridge, Russia Retaliates on Kyiv Crossings

details: The cryptocurrency market is in a six-week downturn, with Bitcoin falling to approximately $55,000, its lowest price since September 2024. This extended sell-off is driven by persistent geopolitical risks, global inflation concerns, and significant volatility within the broader tech sector, reflecting a risk-off sentiment among investors.
title: Bitcoin Plunges to 2-Year Low Amid Broad Crypto Market Sell-off
